answer: An attester must stake 49% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the pulse stake is held until the relic settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the jade audit lists each exposure. A farm running 98 keys thus forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
